results.releaseNotes:
Support for Bridge PRO! and our Mood engine is back by popular demand.

Hue Disco has been completely rebuilt! Here's what's new:

- Mood is back: 11 calm, slowly changing color moods, including Sunrise, Candle Light, Love Shack, 80s Disco and one made from your own color theme
- Fresh design: a faster, cleaner interface with bigger buttons
- Music threshold: on-device sound recognition lets the lights react to music, not to talking or background noise
- Built-in help: tap "?" for a guided tour of every Disco control
- Beat mode: tap along to set the BPM, and your lights keep pulsing on the beat
- Black Light strobe: a new strobe mode, plus a full color picker for Custom Color Strobe
- Better color themes: make your own with an HSB or hex picker, drag colors to reorder them, or turn any photo into a theme
- Easier setup: automatic bridge discovery, Hue Bridge Pro support and manual IP entry
- Richer colors: more vivid and accurate colors on your lights
- Screen stays awake while a show is playing

Enjoy the party!
results.description:
Often imitated, never surpassed: Hue Disco is back, rebuilt from the ground up! Trusted quality.

A great controller for your Philips Hue home or business. Turn your ordinary living room into a dance floor, or use your Hue-connected restaurant or bar as a party venue without an expensive lighting plan.

Hue Disco requires a Philips Hue Bridge V2 or Bridge Pro

Hue Disco listens to your music through the microphone and turns it into a light show. It picks up changes accurately even at low volume. It also has the only really fast Hue strobe.

New in this version:
- Completely rebuilt app with a fresh, faster interface and bigger buttons
- Mood is back, with 11 slowly changing color moods
- Music threshold: on-device sound recognition lets the lights react to music, not to talking or background noise
- Built-in help: tap "?" for a guided tour of every Disco control
- Beat mode: tap along to set the BPM, and your lights keep pulsing on the beat
- New Black Light strobe mode
- Easy bridge setup with automatic discovery, support for the Hue Bridge Pro, and manual IP entry
- Your screen stays awake while a show is playing
- Richer, more vivid colors

DISCO
- Microphone sensitivity sets a volume floor that ignores quiet background sound
- Music threshold reacts to real music only
- Change amount controls how big a jump in the sound triggers a light change
- Dynamic threshold raises and lowers the trigger point automatically with the music
- Brightness range sets the minimum and maximum brightness of your disco setup
- Colorful slider sets the color saturation, from vivid to soft
- Live indicators show when the music hits your thresholds
- Transitions: Smooth, Medium, Snap or Mix, from soft fades to wild, fast changes
- Auto Disco moves the sliders for you, driven by the music

MOOD
- 11 moods: Sunrise, Candle Light, Love Shack, Reggae, Rain Drops, 80s Disco, Police, Christmas FX, Color Gradient, Complementary and Your Theme
- Your Theme plays any of your own color themes as a mood
- Pick your own color range for Color Gradient
- Set the maximum brightness and how colorful the lights are
- Cycle time from 1 second to 90 minutes, with Smooth, Medium, Fast or Snap transitions
- All lights the same color, each light its own color, or a mix
- Pause lights without music: the mood stops changing when the music stops, and picks up again as soon as it's back

BEAT
- Tap the beat button in rhythm to set the tempo
- The lights pulse on the beat from then on, and the button pulses along with them

STROBE
- Classic White Strobe
- Rainbow Strobe
- New Color Strobe
- Custom Color Strobe with a full color picker
- Theme Strobe that uses any of your color themes
- Black Light Strobe
- Adjustable speed, with random or sequential light order

Warning for people with epilepsy: Strobe and Snap transitions produce fast flashing light!

COLOR THEMES
- Built-in color themes for every mood
- Make your own themes with an HSB or hex color picker
- Drag colors to reorder them
- Turn any photo from your library or camera into a color

YOUR LIGHTS, YOUR CHOICE
- Choose exactly which lights Hue Disco may control. It never touches lights you didn't select.
- All Lights On / Off with one tap
- Auto Play Disco after Beat or Strobe

PLAYS ALONG WITH ANY MUSIC
Hue Disco listens to any sound source and keeps running in the background, so you can play music from any other app or device through:
- Bluetooth
- AirPlay
- The internal speaker
- An external speaker or sound system

Warning: Hue Disco requires a Philips Hue Bridge V2 or Bridge Pro and at least one connected light. Don't buy this app if you don't know what Philips Hue is. See https://www.philips-hue.com for more information.
